newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-ENGLAND EYE VICTORY BY INNINGS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND EYE VICTORY BY INNINGS.

text.p: Northern Districts were fighting hard to stave off an innings defeat at the end of the second day of their four-day cricket match against England on Sunday.
Northern Districts were 99 for one wicket at stumps after beginning their second innings needing 225 to make England bat a second time.
Test opener Blair Pocock was on 60 and Matthew Bell had reached 35.
Earlier England had been dismissed for 294 in their first innings, with middle order pair Graham Thorpe and John Crawley top scoring with 71 and 65 respectively.
Medium pacers Alex Tait and Scott Styris picked up 5-96 and 4-110 respectively for Northern Districts.
Bryan Young, Pocock's first-test opening partner, failed for the second time in the match when he followed his first innings four with two on Sunday, caught behind off fast-medium Dominic Cork.
